name: Marketing homepage (/)
description: Public marketing homepage. Adoption-sweep port of marketing.spec.ts 'Homepage (/)' describe block (the structural half: branding heading, key-features section, the How-It-Works section (now 'How the factory works'), hero download/sign-in CTAs). The 'loads without 500' assertion is already covered by the C8 crawl + the run-level same-origin HTTP-500 invariant; this spec adds the structural element-presence assertions the e2e test made (getByRole heading / feature cards / CTA buttons) so the structural coverage survives the nightly-Playwright cutover. Element ids are the ui-bridge SDK auto-assigned ids captured from a ci-bot CI element-dump (the real render): heading-1 is the hero H1 ('State the intent. The factory builds it.'), the key-features section H2 + feature-card H3s, the 'How the factory works' H2, and the hero CTA buttons. Public page: `/` renders this marketing homepage for ANONYMOUS visitors only — as of web #390 an authenticated user who lands on `/` is forwarded to the co-pilot Home (`/co-pilot`) by useLandingPage, so the default authed spec lane would land on co-pilot and never see this content. Tagged `requiresUnauthenticated` so the spec runs through the logged-out lane where `/` still serves the marketing page (the redirect does not fire for an anonymous user). Read-only; structural only.

states.name: Hero section
states.description: Top-of-page hero: the H1 headline. Ports marketing.spec.ts:22/37 (loads + branding heading). NOTE: the header Sign In / Download CTA buttons carry ui-bridge auto-IDs with a render-order index suffix (e.g. button-sign-in-3) that is NOT deterministic across auth states, so we anchor the hero on the stable, unique H1 heading only rather than an index-suffixed button; the unauth Sign-In flow is already covered by the dedicated `login` spec + unauth lane.

assertions.description: Hero H1 headline anchors the page.

states.name: Content sections

'How the factory works' section H2 (it replaced the How-It-Works section in plan 2026-10-09-qontinui-marketing-studio-animated-process-explainers Phase 4).

states.name: Hero scene (S1)
states.description: The hero's animated S1 'Plan lifecycle' scene (plan 2026-10-09-qontinui-marketing-studio-animated-process-explainers Phase 4) and its plan-D2 mode label. Ids are pinned with data-testid in src/components/studio/scene-embed.tsx: scene-embed-<scene> on the figure and scene-mode-<mode>-<scene> on the label, so the label's id says the trace is ILLUSTRATIVE (no replay trace exists yet). The poster frame is server-rendered and the player loads only after the visitor interacts, so this asserts the poster-first structure, not the player.
